   **Bugs and stability.**
      14 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 21, 2026 - Nov 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _seems456_, Nov 13, 2026, 1/5: "I can’t believe this app has such high ratings. It didn’t work for half of this it’s expensive. I realized finally I could do everything directly via my iPhone. I’d asked for a refund when the app repeatedly glitched but that never happened so just posting this to help others avoid dumping their hard earned cash into something glitchy and not worth it."
            2. _Mic_9151_, Nov 12, 2026, 1/5: "All these features yet still super buggy. I would get constant notifications from this app every 30 seconds or so saying I have 10 minutes left, yet no limit in place. Restarting my phone didn’t fix the issue. Along with this, it would straight up brick my phone (frozen) until I restarted it once I hit my limit on any app."
            3. _it is the best gMe of all TIME_, Oct 29, 2026, 1/5: "The app used to be decent until they had a massive UI overhaul and update which is fine if the app still worked, constant crashes, where for months I couldn’t get past the loading screen. Then I got charged the yearly renewal which I imperially went to cancel and try to get a refund for. However despite the support page saying to contact their email they never responded and instead cancelled my pro membership instead, without first even giving the refund or ever contacting me back. Overall this app and company are horrible with a buggy mess of an app. They are many better, free alternatives. I highly recommend skipping on Opal. Just keep in mind if you ever feel like buying the subscription in a few months you may not even be able to use the app anymore."
